project.name: Kotlin to Go Modernization
project.objective: The objective is to modernize a Kotlin-based application into a Go application, focusing on maintaining functionality while updating technology.

at_a_glance.readiness_delta_note: Score is weighted by discovered risk/blocker density (risks=0, high_severity=0, failed_review_checks=1) and extraction coverage. Lower scores across runs usually indicate improved detection coverage, not model instability.
at_a_glance.headline: Full upgrade / translation + remediation recommended.

recommended_strategy.name: Full upgrade / translation + remediation
recommended_strategy.rationale: The application is well-structured for a controlled translation to Go, with clear module boundaries and CI/CD practices.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: Ground BDD acceptance criteria in real legacy golden flows before Build planning.
blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

top_risks.description: Potential data loss during migration to new storage solutions.
top_risks.mitigation: Implement thorough data migration testing and validation.

top_risks.description: Security vulnerabilities during transition to new authentication mechanisms.
top_risks.mitigation: Conduct security audits and implement best practices for Go.

top_risks.description: Lack of familiarity with Go among current development team.
top_risks.mitigation: Provide training and resources for Go development.

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows

out_of_scope: Adding new features beyond current functionality.

items.title: User Authentication and Authorization
items.outcome: Implement user authentication and authorization in Go, ensuring compatibility with existing JWT-based security.
acceptance_criteria: User login and registration endpoints function as expected.
JWT tokens are correctly generated and validated.
Access control is enforced based on user roles.

items.title: Article Management
items.outcome: Re-implement article management functionalities, including CRUD operations, in Go.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create, read, update, and delete articles.
Article data is correctly persisted and retrieved.
API endpoints for articles match existing contracts.

items.title: Comment Management
items.outcome: Migrate comment management features to Go, maintaining current functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add, edit, and delete comments on articles.
Comments are correctly associated with articles.
API endpoints for comments are consistent with existing ones.

items.title: User Profile Management
items.outcome: Implement user profile management in Go, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view and update their profiles.
Profile data is securely stored and retrieved.
API contracts for user profiles remain unchanged.

items.title: Persistent Storage Integration
items.outcome: Update persistent storage solutions to be compatible with Go.
acceptance_criteria: Data is correctly stored and retrieved using the new storage solution.
Migration scripts are provided for data transition.
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed current levels.

items.title: Performance Optimization
items.outcome: Ensure the Go application performs at least as well as the Kotlin version under load.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests show response times under 2 seconds.
Load tests simulate peak user activity without degradation.
Resource usage is optimized for Go.

items.title: Security Compliance
items.outcome: Ensure the Go application adheres to security best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
All sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls are verified and documented.

items.title: Observability and Monitoring
items.outcome: Implement observability features to monitor application health and performance.
acceptance_criteria: All critical operations are logged.
Monitoring dashboards provide real-time insights.
Alerts are configured for critical failures.

items.title: Documentation Quality
items.outcome: Ensure all documentation is comprehensive and up-to-date.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation is reviewed and approved by stakeholders.
Guides are available for all major features.
Documentation is accessible and easy to understand.

items.title: Define identity and access model for modernization scope
items.outcome: Confirm role model, credential policy, and multi-user assumptions before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Remediation implemented and validated against affected legacy flow.
Evidence artifacts updated with before/after traceability.
